outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain map diagram and cropped western blot images, not a quantitative plot showing averaged data.

Bars show single densitometry quantifications per antibody (no error bars or stated replicate number), so they do not represent an average across replicates that would require individual point overlay.

The heatmap encodes the log2 average of two biological replicates per protein/antibody as a colored matrix over 79 proteins; this matrix format is not amenable to overlaying individual replicate values, which is standard practice for heatmaps of this kind.

The violin plot displays the full distribution of enrichment ratios across all co-isolated proteins (population-level data) rather than only a summary statistic, so underlying variability is already visible; the HTT bait value is additionally marked as an individual point.
Bar graphs report mean ± SD (n = 4) and overlay the individual data points for each of the four biological replicates on top of the bars.
This is a sequence alignment and predicted structural model image, not a quantitative plot.
Scatterplots show each individual co-isolated protein as a separate point; no hidden averaging obscures underlying data.
The scatterplot explicitly plots each individual IP-MS experiment as its own data point, as stated in the caption.
PCA plot shows individual sample points per antibody set and tissue rather than averaged summary values.
As in (I), individual sample points are plotted for each antibody set and polyQ length condition, not averaged summaries.
